== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns James Swan. The banns/marriage index records Agnes Glasgow and James Swan on 12 May 1666 at Kirknewton and East Calder.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 690/10 / 55; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
